trigger: on equip / on unequip

effects.creates: GetOrAddComponent<IsadoraSetBuffs> on the player (no-op callbacks)
effects.notes: All item effects are plain data mods in UniqueList.asset (generic unique-mod pipeline). SetItemComponent<T>.EquipUnique (0x180abca50): base.EquipUnique (no-op) -> setBuffs(@0x90) = player.GetOrAddComponent<T>() -> setBuffs.OnSetItemEquipped(this) (vtable 0x178). RemoveUnique (0x180abcad0): Object.Destroy(this) (UniqueItemComponent.RemoveUnique 0x1812566b0) then setBuffs.OnSetItemUnequipped(this) (vtable 0x188). BaseSetBuffs.OnSetItemEquipped/Unequipped are 'ret' and IsadoraSetBuffs/ElementalistSetBuffs override nothing (only ctors), so there is no set logic in code. The component is attached whenever the item is equipped (no item-count gate in code); 2/3-piece bonuses come purely from SetBonusesList.asset mods with setRequirement (handled by generic set-bonus code, not these classes).

Minions have [60,100,1]% Increased Bleed Duration

trigger: on equip + every BaseStats.updateStatsEvent (stat recalculation)
effects.formula: current = min(Stats.GetProtectionValue(SP15 LightningResistance, AT 0, 0,0,0), 40); ChangeStatModifier(SP18 ManaRegen, (current - last) * 0.5, INCREASED); last = current. Net effect: +0.5 x uncapped lightning resistance as increased mana regen
effects.creates: delta-tracked stat modifier SP18 ManaRegen, ModType INCREASED, AT 0
effects.notes: GetProtectionValue (0x1816a0cb0) returns the raw uncapped resistance as a fraction ((1+inc)*added*more, minus the reduction props; ProtectionClass.resistanceCap = 0.75). So the 40 cap is effectively never reached (it would mean 4000% res), most likely a units bug; reproduce as written. Example: 80% uncapped lightning res = 0.8 gives +0.4 (40%) increased mana regen. RemoveUnique calls UpdateModifiers(0), which removes the bonus.

-1% physical and cold resistance per point of dexterity

trigger: on equip + every BaseStats.updateStatsEvent
effects.formula: dex = stats.GetAttributeValue(Dexterity=3) (int); delta = dex - lastDex; for each per-dex stat: ChangeStatModifier(SP, delta*added, ADDED, tags) (and delta*increased with INCREASED if nonzero); lastDex = dex. Net: per point of Dex +1 added Cold damage for Melee/Spell/Throwing/Bow and -1% Physical and -1% Cold resistance
effects.creates: Stats per Dex point: Stat(SP0 Damage, AT 0x204 Cold|Melee, added 1); Stat(SP0, AT 0x104 Cold|Spell, added 1); Stat(SP0, AT 0x404 Cold|Throwing, added 1); Stat(SP0, AT 0x804 Cold|Bow, added 1); Stat(SP64 PhysicalResistance, AT0, added -0.01); Stat(SP14 ColdResistance, AT0, added -0.01)
effects.notes: RemoveUnique unsubscribes then calls UpdateModifiers(0) (delta = -lastDex) to remove everything. Uses total Dexterity from GetAttributeValue (vtable slot 22).

tooltip: You are shocked for 4 seconds when you stop moving

trigger: on state change (actor.stateController(@0x60).stateChangeEvent @0x80); the update tick advances the internal cooldown timer
effects.condition: cooldownIndex >= cooldown (0.5 s since the last proc), from.IsMovingState && !to.IsMovingState (State vfunc 0x3B8), and the player is not already Shocked
effects.formula: ApplyStackOfAilment(AilmentID 5 Shock, incDur 0, incEffect 0) on self; cooldownIndex = 0. OnUpdateTick: if cooldownIndex < cooldown then cooldownIndex += dt
effects.creates: 1 Shock stack on yourself; duration = Shock base duration (4 s, from ailment data, not code). The AilmentID overload passes no creator, so your shock effectiveness does not apply
effects.notes: D? because the vtable slot 0x3B8 name is inferred: it is the same moving-to-not-moving pattern as CharacterMutator.onStateChanged, and get_IsMovingState is the best match. The EquipUnique decompile is truncated; ISIL confirms the subscription to stateController+0x80 via Delegate.Combine.

tooltip: When you hit a bleeding enemy with a melee attack all bleed stacks on that enemy double in speed

trigger: on hit (AbilityEventListener.onHitEvent @0x20, GetComponent on the player)
effects.condition: (ability.tags @0x38 & 0x200 Melee) != 0 and the target has an AilmentReceiver. There is no attack-tag check and no proc chance; it works on any melee hit
effects.formula: for every active Bleed instance on the target: speedIncrease = (speedIncrease + 1) * (1 + 1.0) - 1, i.e. each melee hit doubles the speed of every existing bleed stack. This compounds (x2 per hit) with no cap or cooldown. Higher speed shortens the remaining duration and raises DPS by the same factor
effects.creates: AilmentReceiver.IncreaseSpeedOfExistingAilmentInstances(AilmentID 2 Bleed, 1.0, multiplicative=true, excludeNewInstances=false) (impl 0x18282d0b0: ActiveAilment+0x20 speed field)
effects.notes: Bleeds applied by this same hit are also sped up if they land before the onHit event fires (ordering not verified).

tooltip: 8% increased physical damage for each recent melee hit against a bleeding enemy (up to 400%)

trigger: on hit (AbilityEventListener.onHitEventDetailed via Actor.GetAbilityEventListener)
effects.condition: (dae.tags @0x38 & 0x200 Melee) != 0, the target has an AilmentReceiver, and target.hasAilment(Bleed)
effects.formula: stackIndex += 1; if stackIndex > 50 then stackIndex = 0; add a buff named 'Undisputed axe buff ' + stackIndex of +0.08 increased Physical Damage for 4.0 s (a same-named buff is replaced/refreshed). There are 51 distinct names (0..50), so up to 51 concurrent stacks = 4.08 increased. The tooltip says 400%; the off-by-one is in the code
effects.creates: Buff(Stat(SP0 Damage, AT 1 Physical, added 0, increased 0.08, more 0), 4.0, "Undisputed axe buff N") -> StatBuffs.addBuff
effects.notes: Dual wield: each weapon has its own component and listener, so one hit adds 2 stacks. Both share the same buff-name space, so the cap stays 51 (matches the 'builds twice as fast, same max' tooltip). The tooltip's 'recent melee hit' maps to the 4 s buff. Data mod rollID 2 (SP93 OverkillLeech) is unrelated.
